title: Learn Swedish, Going Out For A Winter Walk

cards.forms: gå ut och gå · är ute och går
cards.sentence_en: Today we're going out for a walk.
cards.note: After ska the verb of motion is often dropped: Vi ska ut = We're going out.

cards.sentence: När vi ska gå ut då går vi till hallen.
cards.sentence_en: When we're going out, we go to the hallway.
This is where you come into the apartment.
cards.note: man = 'one, you, people' in general.

cards.sentence_en: I've put the rubbish here.
cards.note: slänga soporna = to take out the rubbish. One bag of it is en sopåse.

cards.forms: tar med · tog med · har tagit med
cards.sentence_en: We're going to take them out with us.
It's made of cardboard.
cards.note: A cardboard box is en pappkartong; papper = paper.

cards.forms: tar på sig · tog på sig · har tagit på sig
cards.sentence: Men först ska jag ta på mig, för ute är det kallt.
cards.sentence_en: But first I'm going to put some clothes on, because it's cold outside.
cards.note: Opposite: ta av sig.

cards.sentence_en: In here it's warm.
cards.note: inne = inside, ute = outside (where you are, no movement).

cards.sentence_en: Then I put on my jacket.
This is my biggest jacket.

cards.sentence: Nu måste jag ta på mig skor.
cards.sentence_en: Now I have to put on shoes.
A bag is also hanging here.

cards.forms: hänger med · hängde med · har hängt med
cards.sentence_en: You come along.
cards.note: Also 'to keep up': Hänger du med? = Are you following?

cards.sentence: Dörren är låst så jag låser upp.
cards.sentence_en: The door is locked, so I unlock it.

cards.forms: låser upp · låste upp · har låst upp
cards.sentence_en: I unlocked the door.
This is a staircase.
cards.note: One trappa is a whole flight of stairs; one step is ett trappsteg.

cards.sentence_en: Oh, I mustn't forget the rubbish.
I put the key in and turn.

cards.sentence: Här är en stor växt i en stor kruka.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a big plant in a big pot.
That was indoors.
Now we're outdoors.
I'm going to throw the rubbish in the bin room.
cards.note: Swedish apartment blocks have a shared room with bins for sorting waste.

cards.sentence_en: There's snow on the ground.
It has snowed from the sky.
This is the sky.
Where do you live?
cards.note: Var … någonstans? is a very common way to ask 'where?'.

cards.sentence_en: It's cold as hell.
cards.note: Swearing intensifier; fine with friends, not at work. fan = the devil.

cards.english: to go (by vehicle), to drive, to ride
cards.sentence_en: There goes a car.
cards.note: You åker bus, train or car; you går on foot.

cards.sentence_en: This is a road.
I'm walking on the pavement.
Here's a bench.
Behind the bench there are bikes.
cards.note: Opposite: framför = in front of.

cards.sentence: En lång trappa där en människa går upp.
cards.sentence_en: A long staircase where a person is walking up.
It's a high-rise.
cards.note: hög (high) + hus (house).

cards.sentence_en: There are trees there too.

cards.forms: lika stor som · lika högt som
cards.sentence_en: Almost as tall as the house.

cards.forms: går ner för · gick ner för · har gått ner för
cards.sentence_en: I go down the stairs.
cards.note: gå upp för trappan = to go up the stairs.

cards.sentence: Här finns en lyktstolpe men den lyser inte.
cards.sentence_en: Here's a lamppost, but it isn't on.
cards.note: lykta (lantern) + stolpe (post).

cards.sentence: Och här bakom mig finns en jättestor byggnad.
cards.sentence_en: And here behind me there's a huge building.
cards.note: bygga = to build.

cards.sentence_en: Here comes a tram.
cards.note: spår (track) + vagn (carriage).

cards.sentence: Nu ska jag gå upp för trappan hela vägen härifrån dit.
cards.sentence_en: Now I'm going to walk up the stairs all the way from here to there.
cards.note: Movement words: hit = (to) here, dit = (to) there, därifrån = from there.

cards.sentence: Jag gick upp för trappan hela vägen.
cards.sentence_en: I walked up the stairs all the way.

cards.sentence: Jag tar fram ett gammalt kvitto och slänger.
cards.sentence_en: I take out an old receipt and throw it away.
It's a hospital.
cards.note: sjuk (ill) + hus (house).

cards.sentence: På sommaren när det är varmt kan man sitta utomhus och äta.
cards.sentence_en: In summer when it's warm you can sit outdoors and eat.
cards.note: Seasons in general take på + definite form: på vintern = in winter.

cards.sentence: Men jag kan inte se solen för himlen har massa moln.
cards.sentence_en: But I can't see the sun because the sky has lots of clouds.
cards.note: molnig = cloudy: Det är molnigt.

cards.sentence_en: The park is full of snow.

cards.forms: går över · gick över · har gått över
cards.sentence_en: I cross the road.

cards.sentence: Och här bredvid trottoaren, till vänster om trottoaren, finns en buske.
cards.sentence_en: And here next to the pavement, to the left of the pavement, there's a bush.

cards.english: it's not possible, it doesn't work
cards.sentence_en: It won't open.
cards.note: Går det? = Is it possible? / Does it work?

cards.forms: knappar in · knappade in · har knappat in
cards.english: to key in, to enter (a code)
cards.sentence_en: I have to key in the code.
cards.note: en kod = a code; en knapp = a button.

cards.sentence_en: My hand is cold.
cards.note: Jag fryser = I'm cold.

cards.sentence_en: Now we're in the stairwell.
Now I'm home again.
cards.note: hemma = at home (no movement); gå hem = go home.

cards.forms: tar av sig · tog av sig · har tagit av sig
cards.sentence_en: I take off my shoes.
cards.note: Swedes always take their shoes off indoors.

cards.sentence: Jag hänger upp jackan på en krok.
cards.sentence_en: I hang my jacket on a hook.
